subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Use calendars to calculate the length of time in days and weeks; convert between days and weeks, and between weeks and months

show.line: Seven days make a week. About four weeks make a month. Twelve months make a year!

rounds.prompt: Three weeks. How many days? Tap the answer.
rounds.praise: Yes! Three sevens are twenty one.

rounds.prompt: Fourteen days. How many weeks is that?
How many months in a year? Say the number.
Which month has the fewest days?

rounds.story: Zola's birthday is in four weeks. How many days is that?

rounds.prompt: Which month comes just before December?
Count the Saturdays in this month on the calendar.

hints: Weeks to days? Count in sevens.
A month is about four weeks. A year is twelve months.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Two weeks. I will say how many days.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A week has seven days. Two weeks is fourteen days.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count in sevens together. Seven, fourteen. Fourteen days!

parent_line: Can change weeks into days and knows the months of the year.
